moments.title: Catholicism in Japan has an insane aura—it blends so naturally with Japanese aesthetics and visual culture. Yes, that is literally a Christian samurai wielding a sword bearing the image of Jesus. This highlights the fasc
moments.selftext: Catholicism in Japan has an insane aura—it blends so naturally with Japanese aesthetics and visual culture. Yes, that is literally a Christian samurai wielding a sword bearing the image of Jesus. This highlights the fascinating cultural syncretism between Catholicism and traditional Japanese culture. The statue depicts Blessed Justo Takayama Ukon, a 16th-century Christian daimyō (samurai lord) who gave up his wealth and status rather than renounce his faith during the persecution of Christians in Japan. He is shown holding a sword fashioned into a crucifix, while nearby, a woman in a traditional kimono wears an obi decorated with an image of Our Lady of Guadalupe.
